svg.text: MIMIR LAYERS × BUILD ORCHESTRATOR v3 VISION × HUMAN INTERACTION
"如果人类和 AI 在对话中能做到的事情，那这个能力就应该可以被封装，剩下的只是工程问题。"
"If humans and AI can do it in conversation, it should be encapsulable — the rest is engineering."
MIMIR 四层递进 FOUR LAYERS
